description: Telegram has launched a fully native Apple Watch app, bringing direct access to chats, contacts, and messaging tools on watchOS. Users can send and receive messages, listen to voice notes, view stickers, play GIFs and videos, and share locations from their smartwatch. Setup requires scanning a QR code from the Telegram iPhone app and completing cloud password verification if enabled. The release restores official Apple Watch support, which Telegram originally introduced in 2015 before later discontinuing its watchOS application.
title: Telegram Rolls Out Native watchOS App for Apple Watch Users With Support for Texting, Voice Messages and More

description: Vivo Y05e is likely to launch soon. While Vivo remains tight-lipped about the arrival of this new Y series smartphone, it has been spotted on Thailand's National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC) certification website. The listing reveals the model number of the phone. It could feature a 5,050mAh battery. It is expected to be available in a 4GB RAM + 64GB storage option.
title: Vivo Y05e Passes Through Thailand's NBTC Certification Database, Might Launch Soon

description: Researchers studying FCC 224 and FCC 240 in the Fornax Cluster found evidence that both galaxies contain surprisingly little dark matter. The discovery supports the idea that galaxy collisions can strip away dark matter and raises new questions about how galaxies evolve.
title: Astronomers Discover Two Galaxies That Appear to Lack Dark Matter

description: Amazfit has launched three new smartwatches in India, including the Bip Max, Cheetah 2 Pro, and Cheetah 2 Ultra. The Bip Max offers a 2.07-inch AMOLED display, GPS, Bluetooth calling, and up to 20 days of battery life at Rs. 10,999. The Cheetah 2 Pro and Cheetah 2 Ultra target runners and endurance athletes with advanced training metrics, dual-band GPS, Zepp Coach support, and long battery life. The Ultra model additionally offers offline maps, trail-running tools, and up to 60 hours of GPS usage.
title: Amazfit Cheetah 2 Pro, Cheetah 2 Ultra Launched in India Alongside Amazfit Bip Max: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra is expected to be unveiled on July 22. Ahead of it, new hands-on images and video of the phone have leaked online, showcasing the design and wallpapers. The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra appears to have slimmer bezels around the cover display compared to its predecessor. It is expected to feature the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra Design, Wallpapers Seen in Leaked Hands-on Images

description: The European Union has proposed sanctions against 11 crypto platforms as part of its latest sanctions package on Russia. The measures would expand existing restrictions to include digital asset firms allegedly involved in helping sanctioned entities bypass EU rules.
title: EU Seeks to Block Russian Crypto Infrastructure With New Sanctions Package

description: Assassin's Creed Shadows is getting a one last update before post-launch support for the game ends. Ubisoft announced that the game's final udpate, Title Update 1.1.11, will be released on June 16. The update is teased to tie in with the upcoming Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced.
title: Assassin's Creed Shadows' Final Update Arrives Next Week, May Tie in With Black Flag Resynced

description: Netflix announced several product updates at the Asia-Pacific (APAC) Product Innovation Showcase held on Wednesday. The streaming giant detailed a refreshed mobile experience, expanded content discovery tools, and new gaming initiatives for kids and families. Its new additions are claimed to make the streaming service more personalised, interactive, and engaging for users across the Asia-Pacific region. Among the experiences is the expansion of the redesigned mobile to markets like South Korea and Japan beginning next month.
title: Netflix Unveils New Mobile Experience, Announces Games Vision at APAC Innovation Event

description: Realme P4R 5G was launched in India recently with an 8,000mAh battery and MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset. It rivals the OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite 5G and Moto G37 Power 5G in the Indian market. Here's a quick comparison between the Realme P4R 5G,  OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite 5G and Moto G37 Power 5G to help you decide the best pick.
title: Realme P4R 5G vs OnePlus Nord CE 6 Lite 5G vs Moto G37 Power 5G: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: The Asus ExpertBook Ultra (2026) is proof that business laptops no longer need to be utilitarian tools designed solely for spreadsheets and presentations. With a starting price of Rs. 2,39,990, the laptop certainly isn’t cheap. However, if you’re looking for a premium Windows experience that delivers on productivity without sacrificing refinement, then the Asus ExpertBook Ultra (2026) becomes an easy recommendation.
title: Asus ExpertBook Ultra (2026) Review: Where Enterprise Meets Premium

description: EU advisor Peter Kerstens has suggested that the European Commission should focus on tokenisation and digital asset frameworks linked to physical assets before considering a new regulatory framework for DeFi. His comments come as MiCA approaches its July 1 transition deadline.
title: MiCA Architect Urges EU to Focus on Tokenisation Before DeFi Regulation

description: Apple previewed iOS 27 at its recently concluded  Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC 2026). The latest version brings several improvements to Apple Maps. Apple has added a new Flyover experience and a new Local Lists feature for Apple Maps users in iOS 27. The new Flyover experience combines aerial imagery with AI to enable users to view imagery in detail for select cities around the world.
title: Apple Maps to Get AI-Powered Flyover Experience, Local Lists Feature With iOS 27 Update

description: Canva on Wednesday announced the rollout of Canva Offline. It is a new feature designed to let users continue creating and editing designs even without internet access. The company said it is addressing one of the most frequently requested capabilities from its global user community. Offline Mode allows users to keep working on their projects while travelling, commuting, attending classes, or working in areas with unreliable connectivity. It is geared towards mobile-first users, students, educators, entrepreneurs, and professionals.
title: Canva Rolls Out Offline Mode That Enables Content Creation Without an Internet Connection

description: OnePlus has launched the Turbo 6X and Turbo 6X Pro in China with MediaTek Dimensity Super series chipsets, 144Hz displays, and large batteries. The Turbo 6X features a 7,000mAh battery, LCD screen, and support for up to 2TB storage expansion. The Turbo 6X Pro upgrades to a Samsung AMOLED display, an 8,000mAh battery, stronger durability certifications, and a more capable camera system with optical image stabilisation. Both smartphones run Android 16-based ColorOS 16 and will go on sale in China from June 15.
title: OnePlus Turbo 6X Pro Launched With 1.5K AMOLED Screen, 8,000mAh Battery Alongside OnePlus Turbo 6X: Price, Features

description: The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Gen 11 was launched in India on Tuesday as the latest addition to the company’s AI PC lineup. Aimed at students, professionals, and families, the laptop is powered by an Intel Core Ultra Series 3 processor with Copilot+ capabilities. It is available in 14-inch and 15-inch display size options and runs Windows 11. The laptop also supports Lenovo's AI-powered software features and productivity tools. The Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Gen 11 packs a 60Wh battery.
title: Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3 Gen 11 Launched in India With Intel Core Ultra Series 3 Processor, 16GB RAM: Price, Features

description: Xiaomi 17T is now available in India with a Leica-backed triple rear camera system, including a 50-megapixel primary sensor and a 50-megapixel 5x periscope telephoto camera. The smartphone features a 6.59-inch 1.5K AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, MediaTek Dimensity 8500-Ultra chipset, and a 6,500mAh battery with 67W HyperCharge support. It starts at Rs. 59,999, while launch offers reduce the effective starting price to Rs. 54,999. The handset also includes Xiaomi HyperOS 3, Google Gemini integration, and IP68 protection.
title: Xiaomi 17T Goes on Sale in India With 50-Megapixel Leica-Tuned Triple Rear Cameras: Price, Offers

description: Bitcoin slipped closer to $61,000 as traders turned cautious ahead of the US CPI report and Federal Reserve signals. Continued ETF outflows, geopolitical tensions, and weak institutional demand kept sentiment subdued despite signs that long-term holders are not engaging in panic selling.
title: Bitcoin Drops Below $61,300 as Investors Remain Cautious Ahead of US Inflation Data

description: The 50-minute Nintendo Direct presentation was packed with both first- and third-party announcements and reveals for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 platforms. Nintendo revealed the next Zelda release for Switch 2, a remake of Ocarina of Time. The Direct showcase also featured Kingdom Hearts IV and a new Xenoblade game. Here are all the announcements from the latest Nintendo Direct presentation.
title: The Biggest Reveals at Nintendo Direct: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake, Kingdom Hearts IV, More

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 reportedly surfaced in the GSMA database. The listing reveals the device's name and the model number SM-S952U. The listing, dated June 8, does not disclose any specifications of the phone. The Galaxy S27 is expected to launch in early next year alongside the Galaxy S27+ and Galaxy S27 Ultra. The GSMA appearance suggests that Samsung is in the final stages of getting regulatory approvals for the Galaxy S27 family.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Listed on GSMA Database With Model Number Several Months Ahead of Anticipated Release: Report

description: Opera has updated its Android browser with a redesigned home screen that offers quicker access to Google's AI Mode, private browsing, and new customisation options. The update also introduces a dedicated football hub ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026, featuring live scores, match statistics, team notifications, and an AI-powered news feed. Users can customise Speed Dial icons and view weather information directly on the start page. Opera said the changes are based partly on survey findings that highlight strong interest in following the tournament through browsers.
title: Opera for Android Gets New Home Screen With Google AI Mode Shortcut, Football Hub Ahead of FIFA World Cup 2026

description: Realme has launched the Realme P4R 5G in India with an 8,000mAh battery, 45W fast charging, a 6.8-inch 144Hz display, and a 50-megapixel AI-backed camera. The smartphone is powered by the MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset and includes AI features such as AI Eraser 2.0, AI Ultra Clarity, AI Unblur, and support for Google Gemini. It also offers IP65 dust and water resistance and MIL-STD-810H durability certification.
title: Realme P4R 5G Launched in India With an 8,000mAh Battery, MediaTek Dimensity 6300 SoC: Price, Features

description: EU reportedly orders Meta Platforms to provide competing AI chatbot services with free access to WhatsApp while the authorities investigate allegations that the Mark Zuckerberg-led company may have used its market position to restrict rivals' access to the messaging platform. This latest action by the EU is taken based on complaints from The Interaction Company, which develops the Poke.com AI assistant, Agentik, and a Spanish rival.
title: Meta Reportedly Directed to Offer Free WhatsApp Access to Rival AI Chatbots in the EU

title: Bhooth Bangla OTT Release Date Confirmed: When and Where to Watch Akshay Kumar’s Horror-Comedy Online?

description: Google on Wednesday rolled out its latest speech-to-speech translation model called Gemini 3.5 Live Translate. Google claims it is designed to enable more natural multilingual conversations. As per the company, the new AI model can detect more than 70 languages and generate translated speech. The result is claimed to preserve a speaker's tone, pacing, and intonation while continuously delivering near real-time translations. Gemini 3.5 Live Translate is rolling out across Google Translate, Google Meet, Google AI Studio, and the Gemini Live API for developers.
title: Google Rolls Out Gemini 3.5 Live Translate for Real-Time Multilingual Conversations

description: India has reportedly frozen the approval process for Starlink's commercial rollout due to concerns over the use of its satellite terminals during the Iran conflict. Starlink is a key driver of SpaceX's business and growth. It is a crucial time for SpaceX as the firm is expected to announce pricing for its highly anticipated Initial Public Offering on June 12. The company is said to be working closely with Indian authorities for approval.
title: Starlink's India Launch Plans Said to Face Regulatory Hurdles Over Security Concerns Linked to Iran Conflict

description: The Vivo X Fold 6 is scheduled to be launched in China this month as the successor to the X Fold 5. While the company has only revealed a handful of details about the upcoming book-style foldable, a recent leak has showcased one of its standout features. A video recently surfaced on a social media platform, which shows the Vivo X Fold 6 running a new multitasking system called Atomic Bench. It is said to be designed specifically for foldable devices, with features like multi-window capabilities and gesture-based controls.
title: Vivo X Fold 6 Leak Reveals 'Atomic Workbench' and Gesture-Based Multitasking Controls

description: Apple introduced a slew of AI features during the keynote address at the Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC). Part of the Apple Intelligence suite, it announced several upgrades for Siri, the Cupertino-based tech giant’s digital assistant. One of the highlights was the dedicated Siri AI app. The move marked a notable shift in strategy for Apple, with the company previously arguing against building a standalone chatbot experience. The decision was later explained by an Apple executive.
title: WWDC 2026: Craig Federighi Explains Apple's Decision to Launch a Siri AI App

description: OpenAI is reportedly preparing a major overhaul of ChatGPT that will transform the service into a broader AI "superapp" centred on AI agents, coding tools and paid services. According to the Financial Times, the redesign will highlight Codex, image generation features and selected partner applications, while steering users towards revenue-generating products. The company is also increasing its focus on enterprise customers, which already contribute about 40 percent of revenue. The changes are expected to roll out in the coming weeks across ChatGPT's web and mobile apps.
title: ChatGPT Could Soon Become an AI Superapp With Coding Tools and Agents: Report

description: EU regulators criticised Apple on Tuesday for blaming European tech rules for delaying the launch of its upgraded Siri AI in the EU, noting they had refused the company’s request for an 18‑month exemption. Apple said Siri AI would initially be unavailable on EU iPhones and iPads, accusing the Commission of poor engagement, and its proposed intermediary solution was rejected.
title: No Tech Rule Exemption for Apple, EU Regulators Say Amid Spat Over Siri AI Delay

description: The Samsung Galaxy A27 has been in the rumour mill recently, after appearing in several leaks over the past few weeks. A tipster has now leaked the price of the purported handset on social media. It could launch in Europe with a noticeably higher price tag compared to its predecessor, the Galaxy A26. The development comes shortly after the handset appeared on multiple certification platforms, including Malaysia's SIRIM database and the US FCC website.
title: Samsung Galaxy A27 European Pricing Tipped Ahead of Launch; Base Model May See Price Hike
